Follow [the portfolio specification](../docs/specs/portfolio-site-spec.md) and work on one milestone at a time. Ask the owner when requirements are ambiguous.

- Do not add runtime dependencies beyond those listed in the specification.
- Do not invent owner data; keep it in `src/app/site.config.ts`.
- Every user-visible string must have English and French translations.
- Avoid gradients, blurred shadows, glow effects, and generic landing-page copy.
- Keep changes focused and update the README when setup or workflows change.
